name: @immunity-wars/art-pipeline
description: The Clay art pipeline: takes Blender's renders in, gates each on measured contrast, emits WebP at 1x/2x/3x with a manifest that records what was measured.
comment:why-a-package: The contrast gate is the check every picture in the app depends on, and an instrument nobody typechecks is the known failure shape. Workspace member so typecheck and lint reach it; its negative controls run via `pnpm art:clay --control`.
